Solo construction, 31 October 2026. Historical priority unestablished.

1. THE PHYSICAL QUESTION AND THE RESOURCE BEING SUPPLIED

Given partial observations, what is the least entropy production of ONE
stationary time-homogeneous continuous-time Markov dynamics that explains
ALL the observed times? The root minima in virtual_midpoint/ do not answer
this: separately chosen roots need not form a semigroup. This construction
replaces those roots by one common uniformization flow.

Fix a supplied finite escape-rate cap Lambda>0. The class consists of
stationary all-even pure-jump Markov generators Q on standard-Borel hidden
spaces with total exit rate<=Lambda and a fixed finite-alphabet label.
All finite CTMCs satisfying the cap are included. Reducible models are
allowed. The attaining model below is not claimed finite-state. Its precise
finite-state operational interpretation is established in Section6.

The cap is externally supplied UPPER kinetic information, not a mixing
bound. It is NOT estimated from an observation record. Adjoining an
arbitrarily fast independent
reversible hidden bit leaves every observed law and the entropy rate
unchanged, while making the hidden escape rate arbitrarily large. No
passive observation, even an exact continuous observed law, supplies an
upper cap on all compatible hidden dynamics.

Use a known independent Poisson INSPECTION clock of rate nu>0, and initially
observe its label at a stationary start. Only ordered labels need be retained
for the exact-law theorem. Uniformization has a different clock of rate
Lambda. The two clocks MUST NOT be identified:

 P=I+Q/Lambda,

P is the hidden uniformization kernel. B_nu is the actual kernel between
independent inspections. Confusing B_nu with I+Q/nu is generally false.
The receiver includes an exact two-state counterexample with both clock
rates equal2. Neither hidden uniformization events nor virtual self-jumps
are acquired observations.

A CAPPED ROOT HIERARCHY CONVERGES TO ONE COHERENT PHYSICAL GENERATOR
31 October 2026. Population theorem; no new observations or finite-path CI.

This connects the preserved virtual midpoint/quarter roots to PROOF.txt.
It adds a common externally supplied maximum escape-rate cap Lambda.
An unrestricted root hierarchy is not silently assigned this new premise.

Fix a physical grid spacing Delta>0 and a feasible complete stationary
observed law p_grid on that grid, with a deterministic finite state label.
Let I_Lambda(p_grid) be the least stationary all-even entropy-production
rate of a bounded standard-Borel pure-jump generator Q, escape<=Lambda,
whose Delta-grid observations have that ENTIRE law. GRID_INTERFACE.txt
establishes the attained coherent-generator minimization at this scope.

For integer m>=Lambda*Delta, put h=Delta/m. Let

 W_m=inf{e(R)/h : R stationary hidden Markov kernel,
    R(x,{x})>=1-Lambda*h, and observing every m steps
    gives the COMPLETE law p_grid}.                        (R1)

The state space and R may vary with m. Exact finite hidden-state
attainment is not asserted. Diagonal holding is a microscopic cap,
not a condition on the observed label alone. Every such root is

               R=(1-Lambda*h)I+Lambda*h P                 (R2)

for a stationary Markov kernel P. Thus it has an ACTUAL generator
Q_m=(R-I)/h=Lambda(P-I), cap<=Lambda, and

                   sigma(Q_m)=e(R)/h.                    (R3)

This entropy identity is exact: every off-diagonal flow is scaled by
1/h and the diagonal holding flow has zero reversal cost. The physical
semigroup of Q_m need not equal R^m at finite m; that error is charged.

THEOREM:

 W_m<=I_Lambda(p_grid),
             lim_(m->infinity) W_m=I_Lambda(p_grid).       (R4)

If m' is a multiple of m, W_m<=W_m'. In particular, the admissible
dyadic subsequence is nondecreasing and has this same physical limit.
This convergence does not supply a useful universal computation rate.

UPPER DIRECTION. Any compatible Q has R=exp(hQ). Its off-diagonal
probability is at most the chance of a hidden uniformization event,
1-exp(-Lambda*h)<=Lambda*h. Its m-step grid law is exactly p_grid.
Data processing the stationary physical path of duration h to its two
endpoints gives e(R)<=h*sigma(Q). Taking the infimum proves the upper
bound, including the distinction between endpoint entropy and path cost.
